ownerDecisions.summary: R10 mas-harness-operator host-enforcement/; the owner extends the verifier policy from a reviewed package.
Rust for the five native roles.
musl, fully static; W02d's glibc rationale scoped to the CPython roles.
Five modules (with the writer), plus host-image/ and enrollment/ with an off-host signer.

CPYTHON_3_12.libc: glibc 2.34 or later, no CET or shadow-stack arch_prctl at start-up (W02d)

RUST_MUSL_STATIC.linking: static (crt-static, the musl targets' default), self-contained rust-lld

musl.source: rust-lang/rust src/ci/docker/scripts/musl.sh:30 and :36-59, musl-toolchain.sh:54-55 at b940084d

threads.source: musl v1.2.5 src/thread/pthread_create.c:243-245 and :355; src/thread/x86_64/clone.s (SYS_clone 56); src/thread/aarch64/clone.s (SYS_clone 220)
threads.w02d: admitted by NATIVE_STATIC's thread rule (flags & 0x7e030900 == 0x10900); musl never issues clone3, so W02d-QB's clone3 -> ENOSYS rule needs no fallback; musl's posix_spawn (CLONE_VM | CLONE_VFORK) is refused, and only the broker spawns, through its own clone3 (W2). Steady state needs W02d v3 (owner decision Q-S, S-b): musl's mallocng realloc uses mremap(MREMAP_MAYMOVE) above the mmap threshold, thread naming uses prctl(PR_SET_NAME), and musl's abort and raise use tkill

startupRecheck.reference: W02d v2 (MET-ENFORCE-018, pending merge) analysed musl 1.2.5 with Rust 1.90.0 (1159e78c4747b02ef996e55082b704c09b970588) and added poll to NATIVE_STATIC
findings: std's unix init keeps its order (library/std/src/sys/pal/unix/mod.rs init): sanitize_standard_fds, reset_sigpipe, stack_overflow::init, args::init.

sanitize_standard_fds issues one poll on fds 0-2 (musl: SYS_poll on x86_64, ppoll on aarch64, src/select/poll.c); it opens /dev/null only for a closed fd, and 1.99 adds a dup for a further closed fd. open and dup are outside NATIVE_STATIC, so units supply fds 0-2.

stack_overflow::init: the page size comes from the auxiliary vector; on musl install_main_guard_linux_musl returns None without pthread_getattr_np, so no mremap probe runs; rt_sigaction queries and installs SIGSEGV and SIGBUS handlers; mmap and mprotect build the alternate stack; sigaltstack installs it.

New in 1.99: set_current_info records each spawned thread's OS id through the gettid syscall (current_os_id, library/std/src/sys/thread/unix.rs:330-347, called from library/std/src/sys/pal/unix/stack_overflow/thread_info.rs:112-113); gettid is in NATIVE_STATIC. On musl the main thread records no guard range, so the main thread issues no gettid at start. cleanup no longer unmaps the main alternate stack at exit.
musl's __libc_start_main polls fds 0-2 when AT_SECURE is set (src/env/__libc_start_main.c:43-54), which a confined domain transition can set; that is the same poll or ppoll syscall.

startupConstraints: No std::thread::available_parallelism or similar cgroup and /proc reads: NATIVE_STATIC grants no file access, so worker-thread counts are configuration.
Units supply fds 0-2, so neither musl's AT_SECURE start-up check nor Rust std's fd sanitising opens /dev/null or calls dup.
No current_exe, environment-driven paths or locale files; T04 traces the start-up and steady state of each built module on both architectures (SEC-1).
RUST_MUSL_STATIC.crates: vendored with cargo vendor; builds use --locked --offline --frozen; licenses checked against legal/third-party-license-policy.yaml as amended by LIC-HOST (Rust std and core are MIT OR Apache-2.0, accepted by its OR-choice rule); CycloneDX SBOM per artifact

GO_AGENT_BUILD.go: 1.26.7, R10's pinned Go (the module requires go 1.26.0; upstream's Dockerfile uses golang:1.27)
GO_AGENT_BUILD.moduleCache: an offline module cache for a145b01c, inventoried like R10's gomodcache
GO_AGENT_BUILD.build: GOOS=linux, GOARCH amd64 and arm64, CGO_ENABLED=0, static; digests recorded (D-NETPOL-BUILD)

containerd and runc load only cgroup-device programs.
W02d v2, with poll in NATIVE_STATIC, is merged before HE-001 and T04.
Steady-state calls outside NATIVE_STATIC v2: musl realloc's mremap, thread naming's prctl(PR_SET_NAME), abort's and raise's tkill; owner decision Q-S (S-b) adds them in W02d v3, and T04 still traces.

musl's setresuid and setresgid go through __synccall (src/unistd/setxid.c:32), which signals other threads with SYS_tkill (src/thread/synccall.c:67, :82); the broker's W4 child therefore makes the raw setresgid and setresuid syscalls (W01-AMEND review R4-1).
std::thread::available_parallelism opens cgroup and /proc files; native modules take thread counts from configuration (W01-AMEND review R4-1).
Units start every role with fds 0-2 open, so neither musl's AT_SECURE start-up nor Rust std opens /dev/null (W01-AMEND review R4-1).
Rust std and core (MIT OR Apache-2.0) are statically linked into every native module; LIC-HOST's OR-choice rule (owner decision Q-L2) precedes HE-001's license gate.
